local rap = script.Parent.RAP:GetChildren()
local lap = script.Parent.LAP:GetChildren()

local llp = script.Parent.LLP:GetChildren()
local hp = script.Parent.HP:GetChildren()
local tp = script.Parent.TP:GetChildren()
function WELDY(table, weldTo)
	local w2 = Instance.new("Weld")
	w2.Parent = script.Parent.Torso
	w2.Part0 = w2.Parent
	w2.C0 = CFrame.new()
	w2.Part1 = script.Parent.Head
	w2.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0)
	for i = 1, #table do 
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Parent = weldTo
			w.Part0 = w.Parent
			w.C0 = weldTo.CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1 = table[i]
			w.C1 = table[i].CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1.Anchored = false
		end	
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			table[i].Anchored = false
		end
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
end 
function CFRAMEIT(table, weldTo)
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local cf = table[i].CFrame
			local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			v.Name = "CF"
			v.Value = cf
			v.Parent = table[i]
		end
	end
	local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	v.Name = "CF"
	v.Value = weldTo.CFrame
	v.Parent = weldTo
end
function WELDIT(table, weldTo)
	if not weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		WELDY(table, weldTo)
	elseif weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		for i = 1, #table do
			if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
				local w = Instance.new("Weld")
				w.Parent = weldTo
				w.Part0 = w.Parent
				w.C0 = weldTo.CF.Value:inverse()
				w.Part1 = table[i]
				w.C1 = table[i].CF.Value:inverse()
				table[i].Anchored = false
			end
		end
		weldTo.Anchored = false
	end
end
function weld(table, weldTo)
		WELDIT(table, weldTo)
end

local find_Nearest = function()
	local torsos = {}
	for k,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local name = v.Name
		local char = workspace:findFirstChild(name)
		if char then
			local torso = char:findFirstChild'Torso';
			local hum = char:findFirstChild'Humanoid';
			local hv = char:findFirstChild'HealthVal';
			if torso and hum and hv and hum.Health > 0 and hv.Value > 0 then
				if torsos[1] then
					if (ztorso.Position - torso.Position).magnitude <= (ztorso.Position - torsos[1].Position).magnitude then
						table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
					end
				else
					table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return torsos[1]
end
local find_Path = function(endpart)
	local ePos = endpart.Position
	local computedPath = game:GetService'PathfindingService':ComputeSmoothPathAsync(			
	ztorso.Position,
	ePos,
	512
	)
	local pts = computedPath:GetPointCoordinates()
	for i = 1,#pts / 2 do
		sp.Zombie:MoveTo(pts[i])
		sp.Zombie.WalkToPoint = pts[i]
		while wait() do if (ztorso.Position - pts[i]).magnitude <= 6 then break end end
	end
end
function Get_Attacker(Humanoid)
	local Creator = Humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	local Player = nil
	if Creator and Creator.Value and Creator.Value:IsA("Player") then
		Player = Creator.Value
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Humanoid:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Name == "creator" then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return Player
end
function AwardPoints(Player, Currency, Amount)
	if Player then
		local leaderstats = Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if leaderstats then
			local PlayerPoints = leaderstats:FindFirstChild(Currency)
			if PlayerPoints then
				PlayerPoints.Value = (PlayerPoints.Value + Amount)
			end
		end
	end
end
sp.Zombie.HealthChanged:connect(function(NewHealth)
	local Attacker = Get_Attacker(sp.Zombie)
	if Attacker then
		local PlayerAlreadyAttacked = false
		for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
			if v == Attacker then
				PlayerAlreadyAttacked = true
			end
		end
		if not PlayerAlreadyAttacked then
			table.insert(PlayersShotAt, Attacker)
		end
	end
end)
sp.Zombie.Died:connect(function()
	for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
		if v and v.Parent then
			AwardPoints(v, Currency, MoneyAmount)
		end
	end wait(.4)
	sp:Destroy()
end)
sp:WaitForChild'TP'.Damager.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit.Parent ~= nil then 
		if hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid' == nil and hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Zombie' == nil and string.find('bullet',string.lower(hit.Name)) == nil
			and hit.Parent:IsA'Tool' == false then
			sp.Zombie.Jump = true
			obstacle = true
		elseif debounce == false then
			local hum = hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid'
			if hum ~= nil then debounce = true
				
				local x=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'HealthVal';local d=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Down'
				if x~=nil and d.Value==false then x.Value=x.Value-sp.Damage.Value;end
				if x~=nil and x.Value<0 then x.Value=0 end if x~=nil and x.Value<=0 and d.Value==false then
				local y=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Downs'if y then
				y.Value=y.Value+1;d.Value=true;end;end
				
				ztorso.Attack.SoundId = address .. damages[math.random(1,#damages)]
				ztorso.Attack:Play()
				wait(1)
				debounce = false
			end
		end
	end
end)

coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
	while wait(math.random(4,10)) do
		ztorso.Scream.SoundId = address .. screams[math.random(1,#screams)]
		ztorso.Scream:Play()
	end
end))
while wait() do
	local closest_Torso = find_Nearest()
	if obstacle and closest_Torso then
		find_Path(closest_Torso) obstacle = false
	elseif closest_Torso then
		script.Parent.Zombie.WalkToPoint = closest_Torso.Position
	end
end

	local w2 = Instance.new("Weld")

	w2.Part0 = w2.Parent
	w2.C0 = CFrame.new()
	w2.Part1 = script.Parent.Head

	for i = 1, #table do 
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then

			w.Parent = weldTo
			w.Part0 = w.Parent
			w.C0 = weldTo.CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1 = table[i]
			w.C1 = table[i].CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1.Anchored = false
		end	
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			table[i].Anchored = false
		end
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
end 
function CFRAMEIT(table, weldTo)
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local cf = table[i].CFrame
			local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			v.Name = "CF"
			v.Value = cf
			v.Parent = table[i]
		end
	end
	local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	v.Name = "CF"
	v.Value = weldTo.CFrame
	v.Parent = weldTo
end
function WELDIT(table, weldTo)
	if not weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		WELDY(table, weldTo)
	elseif weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		for i = 1, #table do
			if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then

				w.Part0 = w.Parent
				w.C0 = weldTo.CF.Value:inverse()
				w.Part1 = table[i]
				w.C1 = table[i].CF.Value:inverse()
				table[i].Anchored = false
			end
		end
		weldTo.Anchored = false
	end
end
function weld(table, weldTo)
		WELDIT(table, weldTo)
end

function WELDY(table, weldTo)
	local w2 = Instance.new("Weld")
	w2.Parent = script.Parent.Torso
	w2.Part0 = w2.Parent
	w2.C0 = CFrame.new()
	w2.Part1 = script.Parent.Head
	w2.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0)
	for i = 1, #table do 
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Parent = weldTo
			w.Part0 = w.Parent
			w.C0 = weldTo.CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1 = table[i]
			w.C1 = table[i].CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1.Anchored = false
		end	
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			table[i].Anchored = false
		end
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
end 
function CFRAMEIT(table, weldTo)
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local cf = table[i].CFrame
			local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			v.Name = "CF"
			v.Value = cf
			v.Parent = table[i]
		end
	end
	local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	v.Name = "CF"
	v.Value = weldTo.CFrame
	v.Parent = weldTo
end
function WELDIT(table, weldTo)
	if not weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		WELDY(table, weldTo)
	elseif weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		for i = 1, #table do
			if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
				local w = Instance.new("Weld")
				w.Parent = weldTo
				w.Part0 = w.Parent
				w.C0 = weldTo.CF.Value:inverse()
				w.Part1 = table[i]
				w.C1 = table[i].CF.Value:inverse()
				table[i].Anchored = false
			end
		end
		weldTo.Anchored = false
	end
end
function weld(table, weldTo)
		WELDIT(table, weldTo)
end

local s = script
local sp = s.Parent
local plrs = game.Players
local obstacle = false
local debounce = false
local damages = {131138828,131138832,131138835}
local screams = {131060145,131060194,131060210,131060226,131060249}
local address = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="
local PlayersShotAt = {}
local Currency = workspace.MoneyScript.Currency.Value
local MoneyAmount = sp['Money+'].Value
local ztorso = sp:WaitForChild'Torso' repeat wait() until plrs.NumPlayers > 0
local s = Instance.new('Sound',ztorso)
local s1 = Instance.new('Sound',ztorso)
s.Parent = ztorso s.Name = 'Scream'
s1.Parent = ztorso s1.Name = 'Attack'
sp:WaitForChild'Zombie'.Health = sp.Zombie.MaxHealth
local find_Nearest = function()
	local torsos = {}
	for k,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local name = v.Name
		local char = workspace:findFirstChild(name)
		if char then
			local torso = char:findFirstChild'Torso';
			local hum = char:findFirstChild'Humanoid';
			local hv = char:findFirstChild'HealthVal';
			if torso and hum and hv and hum.Health > 0 and hv.Value > 0 then
				if torsos[1] then
					if (ztorso.Position - torso.Position).magnitude <= (ztorso.Position - torsos[1].Position).magnitude then
						table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
					end
				else
					table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return torsos[1]
end
local find_Path = function(endpart)
	local ePos = endpart.Position
	local computedPath = game:GetService'PathfindingService':ComputeSmoothPathAsync(			
	ztorso.Position,
	ePos,
	512
	)
	local pts = computedPath:GetPointCoordinates()
	for i = 1,#pts / 2 do
		sp.Zombie:MoveTo(pts[i])
		sp.Zombie.WalkToPoint = pts[i]
		while wait() do if (ztorso.Position - pts[i]).magnitude <= 6 then break end end
	end
end
function Get_Attacker(Humanoid)
	local Creator = Humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	local Player = nil
	if Creator and Creator.Value and Creator.Value:IsA("Player") then
		Player = Creator.Value
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Humanoid:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Name == "creator" then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return Player
end
function AwardPoints(Player, Currency, Amount)
	if Player then
		local leaderstats = Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if leaderstats then
			local PlayerPoints = leaderstats:FindFirstChild(Currency)
			if PlayerPoints then
				PlayerPoints.Value = (PlayerPoints.Value + Amount)
			end
		end
	end
end
sp.Zombie.HealthChanged:connect(function(NewHealth)
	local Attacker = Get_Attacker(sp.Zombie)
	if Attacker then
		local PlayerAlreadyAttacked = false
		for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
			if v == Attacker then
				PlayerAlreadyAttacked = true
			end
		end
		if not PlayerAlreadyAttacked then
			table.insert(PlayersShotAt, Attacker)
		end
	end
end)
sp.Zombie.Died:connect(function()
	for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
		if v and v.Parent then
			AwardPoints(v, Currency, MoneyAmount)
		end
	end wait(.4)
	sp:Destroy()
end)
sp:WaitForChild'TP'.Damager.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit.Parent ~= nil then 
		if hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid' == nil and hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Zombie' == nil and string.find('bullet',string.lower(hit.Name)) == nil
			and hit.Parent:IsA'Tool' == false then
			sp.Zombie.Jump = true
			obstacle = true
		elseif debounce == false then
			local hum = hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid'
			if hum ~= nil then debounce = true
				
				local x=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'HealthVal';local d=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Down'
				if x~=nil and d.Value==false then x.Value=x.Value-sp.Damage.Value;end
				if x~=nil and x.Value<0 then x.Value=0 end if x~=nil and x.Value<=0 and d.Value==false then
				local y=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Downs'if y then
				y.Value=y.Value+1;d.Value=true;end;end
				
				ztorso.Attack.SoundId = address .. damages[math.random(1,#damages)]
				ztorso.Attack:Play()
				wait(1)
				debounce = false
			end
		end
	end
end)
workspace.GameInProgress.Changed:connect(function(x)sp:Destroy()end)
coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
	while wait(math.random(4,10)) do
		ztorso.Scream.SoundId = address .. screams[math.random(1,#screams)]
		ztorso.Scream:Play()
	end
end))
while wait() do
	local closest_Torso = find_Nearest()
	if obstacle and closest_Torso then
		find_Path(closest_Torso) obstacle = false
	elseif closest_Torso then
		script.Parent.Zombie.WalkToPoint = closest_Torso.Position
	end
end

local zombie = script.Parent:WaitForChild'Zombie'
local ztorso = script.Parent:WaitForChild'Torso'
local LeftShoulder = ztorso:findFirstChild'Left Shoulder'
local RightShoulder = ztorso:findFirstChild'Right Shoulder'
local LeftHip = ztorso:findFirstChild'Left Hip'
local RightHip = ztorso:findFirstChild'Right Hip'
animSpeed = script.Parent.AnimationSpeed.Value
repeat wait() until LeftShoulder and RightShoulder and LeftHip and RightHip
zombie.Running:connect(function(speed)
	if speed > 0 then
		pose = "running"
	else
		pose = "idle"
	end
end)
function Run()
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	wait(1)
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	
	wait(1)
end
function Idle()
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = 0
end
while wait() do
	if pose == "running" then
		repeat wait()
			Run()
		until pose == "running" == false
	end
	if pose == "idle" then
		repeat wait()
			Idle()
		until pose == "idle" == false
	end
end

function Weld(x,y)
	local W = Instance.new("Weld")
	W.Part0 = x
	W.Part1 = y
	local CJ = CFrame.new(x.Position)
	local C0 = x.CFrame:inverse()*CJ
	local C1 = y.CFrame:inverse()*CJ
	W.C0 = C0
	W.C1 = C1
	W.Parent = x
end

function Get(A)
	if A.className == "Part" then
		Weld(script.Parent.Handle, A)
		A.Anchored = false
	else
		local C = A:GetChildren()
		for i=1, #C do
		Get(C[i])
		end
	end
end

function Finale()
	Get(script.Parent)
end

function fire(v)

	local vCharacter = Tool.Parent
	local vPlayer = game.Players:playerFromCharacter(vCharacter)

	local missile = Instance.new("Part")

	
	spark:Clone().Parent = missile

	local spawnPos = vCharacter.PrimaryPart.Position

		PewPew.Parent = Tool.Handle
		PewPew.Volume = 10
	end
	

	spawnPos  = spawnPos + (v * 10)

	
	missile.Position = spawnPos
	missile.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
	missile.Velocity = v * 150
	missile.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(1020)
	missile.Shape = 0
	missile.BottomSurface = 0
	missile.TopSurface = 0
	missile.Name = "Spark"
	missile.Reflectance = .5


	local force = Instance.new("BodyForce")

	force.Parent = missile

	missile.Parent = game.Workspace

function onActivated()
	if not enabled  then
		return
	end

	enabled = false


	local character = Tool.Parent;
	local humanoid = character.Humanoid
	if humanoid == nil then
		print("Humanoid not found")
		return 
	end

	local targetPos = humanoid.TargetPoint

	local reload = .140

	--end

	gunUp()
	fire(lookAt)
	wait(reload)
	gunOut()
	wait(reload)

	enabled = true

local RightShoulder = ztorso:findFirstChild'Right Shoulder'
local LeftHip = ztorso:findFirstChild'Left Hip'
local RightHip = ztorso:findFirstChild'Right Hip'
animSpeed = script.Parent.AnimationSpeed.Value
repeat wait() until LeftShoulder and RightShoulder and LeftHip and RightHip
zombie.Running:connect(function(speed)
	if speed > 0 then
		pose = "running"
	else
		pose = "idle"
	end
end)
function Run()
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	wait(1)
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	
	wait(1)
end
function Idle()
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = 0
end
while wait() do
	if pose == "running" then
		repeat wait()
			Run()
		until pose == "running" == false
	end
	if pose == "idle" then
		repeat wait()
			Idle()
		until pose == "idle" == false
	end
end

local rap = script.Parent.RAP:GetChildren()
local lap = script.Parent.LAP:GetChildren()

local llp = script.Parent.LLP:GetChildren()
local hp = script.Parent.HP:GetChildren()
local tp = script.Parent.TP:GetChildren()
function WELDY(table, weldTo)
	local w2 = Instance.new("Weld")
	w2.Parent = script.Parent.Torso
	w2.Part0 = w2.Parent
	w2.C0 = CFrame.new()
	w2.Part1 = script.Parent.Head
	w2.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0)
	for i = 1, #table do 
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Parent = weldTo
			w.Part0 = w.Parent
			w.C0 = weldTo.CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1 = table[i]
			w.C1 = table[i].CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1.Anchored = false
		end	
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			table[i].Anchored = false
		end
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
end 
function CFRAMEIT(table, weldTo)
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local cf = table[i].CFrame
			local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			v.Name = "CF"
			v.Value = cf
			v.Parent = table[i]
		end
	end
	local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	v.Name = "CF"
	v.Value = weldTo.CFrame
	v.Parent = weldTo
end
function WELDIT(table, weldTo)
	if not weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		WELDY(table, weldTo)
	elseif weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		for i = 1, #table do
			if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
				local w = Instance.new("Weld")
				w.Parent = weldTo
				w.Part0 = w.Parent
				w.C0 = weldTo.CF.Value:inverse()
				w.Part1 = table[i]
				w.C1 = table[i].CF.Value:inverse()
				table[i].Anchored = false
			end
		end
		weldTo.Anchored = false
	end
end
function weld(table, weldTo)
		WELDIT(table, weldTo)
end

	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	wait(1)
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	
	wait(1)
end
function Idle()

	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = 0
end
while wait() do
	if pose == "running" then
		repeat wait()
			Run()
		until pose == "running" == false
	end
	if pose == "idle" then
		repeat wait()
			Idle()
		until pose == "idle" == false
	end
end

function WELDY(table, weldTo)
	local w2 = Instance.new("Weld")
	w2.Parent = script.Parent.Torso
	w2.Part0 = w2.Parent
	w2.C0 = CFrame.new()
	w2.Part1 = script.Parent.Head
	w2.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0)
	for i = 1, #table do 
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Parent = weldTo
			w.Part0 = w.Parent
			w.C0 = weldTo.CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1 = table[i]
			w.C1 = table[i].CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1.Anchored = false
		end	
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			table[i].Anchored = false
		end
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
end 
function CFRAMEIT(table, weldTo)
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local cf = table[i].CFrame
			local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			v.Name = "CF"
			v.Value = cf
			v.Parent = table[i]
		end
	end
	local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	v.Name = "CF"
	v.Value = weldTo.CFrame
	v.Parent = weldTo
end
function WELDIT(table, weldTo)
	if not weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		WELDY(table, weldTo)
	elseif weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		for i = 1, #table do
			if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
				local w = Instance.new("Weld")
				w.Parent = weldTo
				w.Part0 = w.Parent
				w.C0 = weldTo.CF.Value:inverse()
				w.Part1 = table[i]
				w.C1 = table[i].CF.Value:inverse()
				table[i].Anchored = false
			end
		end
		weldTo.Anchored = false
	end
end
function weld(table, weldTo)
		WELDIT(table, weldTo)
end

local s = script
local sp = s.Parent
local plrs = game.Players
local obstacle = false
local debounce = false
local damages = {131138828,131138832,131138835}
local screams = {131060145,131060194,131060210,131060226,131060249}
local address = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="
local PlayersShotAt = {}
local Currency = workspace.MoneyScript.Currency.Value
local MoneyAmount = sp['Money+'].Value
local ztorso = sp:WaitForChild'Torso' repeat wait() until plrs.NumPlayers > 0
local s = Instance.new('Sound',ztorso)
local s1 = Instance.new('Sound',ztorso)
s.Parent = ztorso s.Name = 'Scream'
s1.Parent = ztorso s1.Name = 'Attack'
sp:WaitForChild'Zombie'.Health = sp.Zombie.MaxHealth
local find_Nearest = function()
	local torsos = {}
	for k,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local name = v.Name
		local char = workspace:findFirstChild(name)
		if char then
			local torso = char:findFirstChild'Torso';
			local hum = char:findFirstChild'Humanoid';
			local hv = char:findFirstChild'HealthVal';
			if torso and hum and hv and hum.Health > 0 and hv.Value > 0 then
				if torsos[1] then
					if (ztorso.Position - torso.Position).magnitude <= (ztorso.Position - torsos[1].Position).magnitude then
						table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
					end
				else
					table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return torsos[1]
end
local find_Path = function(endpart)
	local ePos = endpart.Position
	local computedPath = game:GetService'PathfindingService':ComputeSmoothPathAsync(			
	ztorso.Position,
	ePos,
	512
	)
	local pts = computedPath:GetPointCoordinates()
	for i = 1,#pts / 2 do
		sp.Zombie:MoveTo(pts[i])
		sp.Zombie.WalkToPoint = pts[i]
		while wait() do if (ztorso.Position - pts[i]).magnitude <= 6 then break end end
	end
end
function Get_Attacker(Humanoid)
	local Creator = Humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	local Player = nil
	if Creator and Creator.Value and Creator.Value:IsA("Player") then
		Player = Creator.Value
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Humanoid:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Name == "creator" then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return Player
end
function AwardPoints(Player, Currency, Amount)
	if Player then
		local leaderstats = Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if leaderstats then
			local PlayerPoints = leaderstats:FindFirstChild(Currency)
			if PlayerPoints then
				PlayerPoints.Value = (PlayerPoints.Value + Amount)
			end
		end
	end
end
sp.Zombie.HealthChanged:connect(function(NewHealth)
	local Attacker = Get_Attacker(sp.Zombie)
	if Attacker then
		local PlayerAlreadyAttacked = false
		for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
			if v == Attacker then
				PlayerAlreadyAttacked = true
			end
		end
		if not PlayerAlreadyAttacked then
			table.insert(PlayersShotAt, Attacker)
		end
	end
end)
sp.Zombie.Died:connect(function()
	for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
		if v and v.Parent then
			AwardPoints(v, Currency, MoneyAmount)
		end
	end wait(.4)
	sp:Destroy()
end)
sp:WaitForChild'TP'.Damager.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit.Parent ~= nil then 
		if hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid' == nil and hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Zombie' == nil and string.find('bullet',string.lower(hit.Name)) == nil
			and hit.Parent:IsA'Tool' == false then
			sp.Zombie.Jump = true
			obstacle = true
		elseif debounce == false then
			local hum = hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid'
			if hum ~= nil then debounce = true
				
				local x=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'HealthVal';local d=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Down'
				if x~=nil and d.Value==false then x.Value=x.Value-sp.Damage.Value;end
				if x~=nil and x.Value<0 then x.Value=0 end if x~=nil and x.Value<=0 and d.Value==false then
				local y=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Downs'if y then
				y.Value=y.Value+1;d.Value=true;end;end
				
				ztorso.Attack.SoundId = address .. damages[math.random(1,#damages)]
				ztorso.Attack:Play()
				wait(1)
				debounce = false
			end
		end
	end
end)
workspace.GameInProgress.Changed:connect(function(x)sp:Destroy()end)
coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
	while wait(math.random(4,10)) do
		ztorso.Scream.SoundId = address .. screams[math.random(1,#screams)]
		ztorso.Scream:Play()
	end
end))
while wait() do
	local closest_Torso = find_Nearest()
	if obstacle and closest_Torso then
		find_Path(closest_Torso) obstacle = false
	elseif closest_Torso then
		script.Parent.Zombie.WalkToPoint = closest_Torso.Position
	end
end

		if char then
			local torso = char:findFirstChild'Torso';
			local hum = char:findFirstChild'Humanoid';

			if torso and hum and hv and hum.Health > 0 and hv.Value > 0 then

				end
			end
		end
	end
	return torsos[1]
end

	local ePos = endpart.Position
	local computedPath = game:GetService'PathfindingService':ComputeSmoothPathAsync(			
	ztorso.Position,
	ePos,
	512
	)
	local pts = computedPath:GetPointCoordinates()
	for i = 1,#pts / 2 do
		sp.Zombie:MoveTo(pts[i])
		sp.Zombie.WalkToPoint = pts[i]
		while wait() do if (ztorso.Position - pts[i]).magnitude <= 6 then break end end
	end
end

	local Creator = Humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")

	if Creator and Creator.Value and Creator.Value:IsA("Player") then

function WELDY(table, weldTo)
	local w2 = Instance.new("Weld")
	w2.Parent = script.Parent.Torso
	w2.Part0 = w2.Parent
	w2.C0 = CFrame.new()
	w2.Part1 = script.Parent.Head
	w2.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0)
	for i = 1, #table do 
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Parent = weldTo
			w.Part0 = w.Parent
			w.C0 = weldTo.CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1 = table[i]
			w.C1 = table[i].CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1.Anchored = false
		end	
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			table[i].Anchored = false
		end
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
end 
function CFRAMEIT(table, weldTo)
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local cf = table[i].CFrame
			local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			v.Name = "CF"
			v.Value = cf
			v.Parent = table[i]
		end
	end
	local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	v.Name = "CF"
	v.Value = weldTo.CFrame
	v.Parent = weldTo
end
function WELDIT(table, weldTo)
	if not weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		WELDY(table, weldTo)
	elseif weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		for i = 1, #table do
			if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
				local w = Instance.new("Weld")
				w.Parent = weldTo
				w.Part0 = w.Parent
				w.C0 = weldTo.CF.Value:inverse()
				w.Part1 = table[i]
				w.C1 = table[i].CF.Value:inverse()
				table[i].Anchored = false
			end
		end
		weldTo.Anchored = false
	end
end
function weld(table, weldTo)
		WELDIT(table, weldTo)
end

local RightShoulder = ztorso:findFirstChild'Right Shoulder'
local LeftHip = ztorso:findFirstChild'Left Hip'
local RightHip = ztorso:findFirstChild'Right Hip'
animSpeed = script.Parent.AnimationSpeed.Value
repeat wait() until LeftShoulder and RightShoulder and LeftHip and RightHip
zombie.Running:connect(function(speed)
	if speed > 0 then
		pose = "running"
	else
		pose = "idle"
	end
end)
function Run()
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	wait(1)
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	
	wait(1)
end
function Idle()
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = 0
end
while wait() do
	if pose == "running" then
		repeat wait()
			Run()
		until pose == "running" == false
	end
	if pose == "idle" then
		repeat wait()
			Idle()
		until pose == "idle" == false
	end
end

local rap = script.Parent.RAP:GetChildren()
local lap = script.Parent.LAP:GetChildren()
local rlp = script.Parent.RLP:GetChildren()
local llp = script.Parent.LLP:GetChildren()
local hp = script.Parent.HP:GetChildren()
local tp = script.Parent.TP:GetChildren()
function WELDY(table, weldTo)
	local w2 = Instance.new("Weld")
	w2.Parent = script.Parent.Torso
	w2.Part0 = w2.Parent
	w2.C0 = CFrame.new()
	w2.Part1 = script.Parent.Head
	w2.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0)
	for i = 1, #table do 
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Parent = weldTo
			w.Part0 = w.Parent
			w.C0 = weldTo.CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1 = table[i]
			w.C1 = table[i].CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1.Anchored = false
		end	
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			table[i].Anchored = false
		end
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
end 
function CFRAMEIT(table, weldTo)
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local cf = table[i].CFrame
			local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			v.Name = "CF"
			v.Value = cf
			v.Parent = table[i]
		end
	end
	local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	v.Name = "CF"
	v.Value = weldTo.CFrame
	v.Parent = weldTo
end
function WELDIT(table, weldTo)
	if not weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		WELDY(table, weldTo)
	elseif weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		for i = 1, #table do
			if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
				local w = Instance.new("Weld")
				w.Parent = weldTo
				w.Part0 = w.Parent
				w.C0 = weldTo.CF.Value:inverse()
				w.Part1 = table[i]
				w.C1 = table[i].CF.Value:inverse()
				table[i].Anchored = false
			end
		end
		weldTo.Anchored = false
	end
end
function weld(table, weldTo)
		WELDIT(table, weldTo)
end

local s = script
local sp = s.Parent
local plrs = game.Players
local obstacle = false
local debounce = false
local damages = {131138828,131138832,131138835}
local screams = {131060145,131060194,131060210,131060226,131060249}
local address = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="
local PlayersShotAt = {}
local Currency = workspace.MoneyScript.Currency.Value
local MoneyAmount = sp['Money+'].Value
local ztorso = sp:WaitForChild'Torso' repeat wait() until plrs.NumPlayers > 0
local s = Instance.new('Sound',ztorso)
local s1 = Instance.new('Sound',ztorso)
s.Parent = ztorso s.Name = 'Scream'
s1.Parent = ztorso s1.Name = 'Attack'
sp:WaitForChild'Zombie'.Health = sp.Zombie.MaxHealth
local find_Nearest = function()
	local torsos = {}
	for k,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local name = v.Name
		local char = workspace:findFirstChild(name)
		if char then
			local torso = char:findFirstChild'Torso';
			local hum = char:findFirstChild'Humanoid';
			local hv = char:findFirstChild'HealthVal';
			if torso and hum and hv and hum.Health > 0 and hv.Value > 0 then
				if torsos[1] then
					if (ztorso.Position - torso.Position).magnitude <= (ztorso.Position - torsos[1].Position).magnitude then
						table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
					end
				else
					table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return torsos[1]
end
local find_Path = function(endpart)
	local ePos = endpart.Position
	local computedPath = game:GetService'PathfindingService':ComputeSmoothPathAsync(			
	ztorso.Position,
	ePos,
	512
	)
	local pts = computedPath:GetPointCoordinates()
	for i = 1,#pts / 2 do
		sp.Zombie:MoveTo(pts[i])
		sp.Zombie.WalkToPoint = pts[i]
		while wait() do if (ztorso.Position - pts[i]).magnitude <= 6 then break end end
	end
end
function Get_Attacker(Humanoid)
	local Creator = Humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	local Player = nil
	if Creator and Creator.Value and Creator.Value:IsA("Player") then
		Player = Creator.Value
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Humanoid:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Name == "creator" then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return Player
end
function AwardPoints(Player, Currency, Amount)
	if Player then
		local leaderstats = Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if leaderstats then
			local PlayerPoints = leaderstats:FindFirstChild(Currency)
			if PlayerPoints then
				PlayerPoints.Value = (PlayerPoints.Value + Amount)
			end
		end
	end
end
sp.Zombie.HealthChanged:connect(function(NewHealth)
	local Attacker = Get_Attacker(sp.Zombie)
	if Attacker then
		local PlayerAlreadyAttacked = false
		for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
			if v == Attacker then
				PlayerAlreadyAttacked = true
			end
		end
		if not PlayerAlreadyAttacked then
			table.insert(PlayersShotAt, Attacker)
		end
	end
end)
sp.Zombie.Died:connect(function()
	for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
		if v and v.Parent then
			AwardPoints(v, Currency, MoneyAmount)
		end
	end wait(.4)
	sp:Destroy()
end)
sp:WaitForChild'TP'.Damager.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit.Parent ~= nil then 
		if hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid' == nil and hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Zombie' == nil and string.find('bullet',string.lower(hit.Name)) == nil
			and hit.Parent:IsA'Tool' == false then
			sp.Zombie.Jump = true
			obstacle = true
		elseif debounce == false then
			local hum = hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid'
			if hum ~= nil then debounce = true
				
				local x=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'HealthVal';local d=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Down'
				if x~=nil and d.Value==false then x.Value=x.Value-sp.Damage.Value;end
				if x~=nil and x.Value<0 then x.Value=0 end if x~=nil and x.Value<=0 and d.Value==false then
				local y=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Downs'if y then
				y.Value=y.Value+1;d.Value=true;end;end
				
				ztorso.Attack.SoundId = address .. damages[math.random(1,#damages)]
				ztorso.Attack:Play()
				wait(1)
				debounce = false
			end
		end
	end
end)
workspace.GameInProgress.Changed:connect(function(x)sp:Destroy()end)
coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
	while wait(math.random(4,10)) do
		ztorso.Scream.SoundId = address .. screams[math.random(1,#screams)]
		ztorso.Scream:Play()
	end
end))
while wait() do
	local closest_Torso = find_Nearest()
	if obstacle and closest_Torso then
		find_Path(closest_Torso) obstacle = false
	elseif closest_Torso then
		script.Parent.Zombie.WalkToPoint = closest_Torso.Position
	end
end

local damages = {131138828,131138832,131138835}
local screams = {131060145,131060194,131060210,131060226,131060249}
local address = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="
local PlayersShotAt = {}
local Currency = workspace.MoneyScript.Currency.Value
local MoneyAmount = sp['Money+'].Value
local ztorso = sp:WaitForChild'Torso' repeat wait() until plrs.NumPlayers > 0
local s = Instance.new('Sound',ztorso)
local s1 = Instance.new('Sound',ztorso)
s.Parent = ztorso s.Name = 'Scream'
s1.Parent = ztorso s1.Name = 'Attack'
sp:WaitForChild'Zombie'.Health = sp.Zombie.MaxHealth
local find_Nearest = function()
	local torsos = {}
	for k,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local name = v.Name
		local char = workspace:findFirstChild(name)
		if char then
			local torso = char:findFirstChild'Torso';
			local hum = char:findFirstChild'Humanoid';
			local hv = char:findFirstChild'HealthVal';
			if torso and hum and hv and hum.Health > 0 and hv.Value > 0 then
				if torsos[1] then
					if (ztorso.Position - torso.Position).magnitude <= (ztorso.Position - torsos[1].Position).magnitude then
						table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
					end
				else
					table.insert(torsos,1,torso)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return torsos[1]
end
local find_Path = function(endpart)
	local ePos = endpart.Position
	local computedPath = game:GetService'PathfindingService':ComputeSmoothPathAsync(			
	ztorso.Position,
	ePos,
	512
	)
	local pts = computedPath:GetPointCoordinates()
	for i = 1,#pts / 2 do
		sp.Zombie:MoveTo(pts[i])
		sp.Zombie.WalkToPoint = pts[i]
		while wait() do if (ztorso.Position - pts[i]).magnitude <= 6 then break end end
	end
end
function Get_Attacker(Humanoid)
	local Creator = Humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	local Player = nil
	if Creator and Creator.Value and Creator.Value:IsA("Player") then
		Player = Creator.Value
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Humanoid:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Name == "creator" then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return Player
end
function AwardPoints(Player, Currency, Amount)
	if Player then
		local leaderstats = Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if leaderstats then
			local PlayerPoints = leaderstats:FindFirstChild(Currency)
			if PlayerPoints then
				PlayerPoints.Value = (PlayerPoints.Value + Amount)
			end
		end
	end
end
sp.Zombie.HealthChanged:connect(function(NewHealth)
	local Attacker = Get_Attacker(sp.Zombie)
	if Attacker then
		local PlayerAlreadyAttacked = false
		for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
			if v == Attacker then
				PlayerAlreadyAttacked = true
			end
		end
		if not PlayerAlreadyAttacked then
			table.insert(PlayersShotAt, Attacker)
		end
	end
end)
sp.Zombie.Died:connect(function()
	for i, v in pairs(PlayersShotAt) do
		if v and v.Parent then
			AwardPoints(v, Currency, MoneyAmount)
		end
	end wait(.4)
	sp:Destroy()
end)
sp:WaitForChild'TP'.Damager.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	if hit.Parent ~= nil then 
		if hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid' == nil and hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Zombie' == nil and string.find('bullet',string.lower(hit.Name)) == nil
			and hit.Parent:IsA'Tool' == false then
			sp.Zombie.Jump = true
			obstacle = true
		elseif debounce == false then
			local hum = hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Humanoid'
			if hum ~= nil then debounce = true
				
				local x=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'HealthVal';local d=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Down'
				if x~=nil and d.Value==false then x.Value=x.Value-sp.Damage.Value;end
				if x~=nil and x.Value<0 then x.Value=0 end if x~=nil and x.Value<=0 and d.Value==false then
				local y=hit.Parent:findFirstChild'Downs'if y then
				y.Value=y.Value+1;d.Value=true;end;end
				
				ztorso.Attack.SoundId = address .. damages[math.random(1,#damages)]
				ztorso.Attack:Play()
				wait(1)
				debounce = false
			end
		end
	end
end)
workspace.GameInProgress.Changed:connect(function(x)sp:Destroy()end)
coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
	while wait(math.random(4,10)) do
		ztorso.Scream.SoundId = address .. screams[math.random(1,#screams)]
		ztorso.Scream:Play()
	end
end))
while wait() do
	local closest_Torso = find_Nearest()
	if obstacle and closest_Torso then
		find_Path(closest_Torso) obstacle = false
	elseif closest_Torso then
		script.Parent.Zombie.WalkToPoint = closest_Torso.Position
	end
end

local zombie = script.Parent:WaitForChild'Zombie'
local ztorso = script.Parent:WaitForChild'Torso'
local LeftShoulder = ztorso:findFirstChild'Left Shoulder'
local RightShoulder = ztorso:findFirstChild'Right Shoulder'
local LeftHip = ztorso:findFirstChild'Left Hip'
local RightHip = ztorso:findFirstChild'Right Hip'
animSpeed = script.Parent.AnimationSpeed.Value
repeat wait() until LeftShoulder and RightShoulder and LeftHip and RightHip
zombie.Running:connect(function(speed)
	if speed > 0 then
		pose = "running"
	else
		pose = "idle"
	end
end)
function Run()
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed
	wait(1)
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = -0.5
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0.5
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = animSpeed - animSpeed - animSpeed
	
	wait(1)
end
function Idle()
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = 0
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0	
	LeftHip.MaxVelocity = 0
	RightHip.MaxVelocity = 0
end
while wait() do
	if pose == "running" then
		repeat wait()
			Run()
		until pose == "running" == false
	end
	if pose == "idle" then
		repeat wait()
			Idle()
		until pose == "idle" == false
	end
end

local rap = script.Parent.RAP:GetChildren()
local lap = script.Parent.LAP:GetChildren()
local rlp = script.Parent.RLP:GetChildren()
local llp = script.Parent.LLP:GetChildren()
local hp = script.Parent.HP:GetChildren()
local tp = script.Parent.TP:GetChildren()
function WELDY(table, weldTo)
	local w2 = Instance.new("Weld")
	w2.Parent = script.Parent.Torso
	w2.Part0 = w2.Parent
	w2.C0 = CFrame.new()
	w2.Part1 = script.Parent.Head
	w2.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0)
	for i = 1, #table do 
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Parent = weldTo
			w.Part0 = w.Parent
			w.C0 = weldTo.CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1 = table[i]
			w.C1 = table[i].CFrame:inverse()
			w.Part1.Anchored = false
		end	
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			table[i].Anchored = false
		end
	end
	weldTo.Anchored = false
end 
function CFRAMEIT(table, weldTo)
	for i = 1, #table do
		if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
			local cf = table[i].CFrame
			local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			v.Name = "CF"
			v.Value = cf
			v.Parent = table[i]
		end
	end
	local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	v.Name = "CF"
	v.Value = weldTo.CFrame
	v.Parent = weldTo
end
function WELDIT(table, weldTo)
	if not weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		WELDY(table, weldTo)
	elseif weldTo:findFirstChild("CF") then
		for i = 1, #table do
			if table[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
				local w = Instance.new("Weld")
				w.Parent = weldTo
				w.Part0 = w.Parent
				w.C0 = weldTo.CF.Value:inverse()
				w.Part1 = table[i]
				w.C1 = table[i].CF.Value:inverse()
				table[i].Anchored = false
			end
		end
		weldTo.Anchored = false
	end
end
function weld(table, weldTo)
		WELDIT(table, weldTo)
end

function WeldModel(PrimaryPart, SecondaryPart, Model)
	Weld = Instance.new("Weld", PrimaryPart)
	Weld.Part0 = PrimaryPart
	Weld.Part1 = SecondaryPart
	SecondaryPart.Anchored = false 
	for i, v in pairs(Model:GetChildren()) do 
		if v:IsA("BasePart") and v == SecondaryPart == false then 
			Weld = Instance.new("Weld", SecondaryPart)
			Weld.Part0 = SecondaryPart
			Weld.Part1 = v
			Weld.C0 = Weld.Part0.CFrame:inverse() * Weld.Part0.CFrame
			Weld.C1 = Weld.Part1.CFrame:inverse() * Weld.Part0.CFrame
			v.CanCollide = false 
			v.Anchored = false 
		end 
	end 
end 
function GatherSpawns(Parent)
	for i, v in pairs(Parent:GetChildren()) do 
		GatherSpawns(v)
		if v:IsA("BasePart") and string.lower(v.Name) == string.lower("ZombieSpawn") then 
			table.insert(Spawns, v)
		end 
	end 
end

local On = false
local msgText = 'WINNER!'
local Msg

local function partTouched(hit)
	if On then return end
	On = true
	local Humanoid = hit.Parent:findFirstChild('Humanoid')
	if not Humanoid then On = false return end
	Msg = Instance.new('Message',workspace)
	Msg.Text = msgText
	wait(5)
	for i,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if v.Character then
			v.Character:BreakJoints()
		end
	end
	wait(1)
	Msg:Destroy()
	Msg = nil
	On = false
end

script.Parent.Touched:connect(partTouched)

function GO(h)
	if h then
		if h.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			script.Parent.Hole.Transparency = 0
			for i = 1, math.random(5, 10) do
			local s = script.Script:clone()
				s.Parent = p
				s.Disabled = false
			end
			local zombie = game.Lighting.Zombie7:clone()

			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Name = "Neck"
			w.Parent = zombie.Torso
			w.Part0 = zombie.Torso
			w.Part1 = zombie.Head
			w.C0 = CFrame.new()
			w.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0)	
			
			zombie:MakeJoints()
			zombie.Torso.CFrame = script.Parent.Hole.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
			zombie.Parent = game.Workspace
			zombie.ChaseScript.Damage.Value = script.Damage.Value
			zombie.ChaseScript.Range.Value = script.Range.Value
			zombie.Zombie.WalkSpeed = script.Speed.Value
			zombie.Zombie.MaxHealth = script.Health.Value
			zombie.Zombie.Health = zombie.Zombie.MaxHealth
			zombie:MakeJoints()
			--zombie:MoveTo(script.Parent.Hole.Position)
			--zombie.Torso.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
			local s = zombie:GetChildren()
			for i = 1, #s do
				if s[i]:IsA("Script") then
					s[i].Disabled = false
				end
			end
			local f = Instance.new("BodyForce")
			f.force = Vector3.new(0, 0000, 0)
			f.Parent = zombie.Torso
			wait(0)
			f:remove()
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
end

function blow(hit)
	if (hit.Parent == nil) then return end -- happens when bullet hits sword

	local humanoid = hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid")
	local vCharacter = Tool.Parent
	local vPlayer = game.Players:playerFromCharacter(vCharacter)
	local hum = vCharacter:findFirstChild("Humanoid") -- non-nil if tool held by a character
	if humanoid~=nil and humanoid ~= hum and hum ~= nil then
		-- final check, make sure sword is in-hand

		local right_arm = vCharacter:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
		if (right_arm ~= nil) then
			local joint = right_arm:FindFirstChild("RightGrip")
			if (joint ~= nil and (joint.Part0 == sword or joint.Part1 == sword)) then
				tagHumanoid(humanoid, vPlayer)
				humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
				wait(1)
				untagHumanoid(humanoid)
			end
		end


	end
end


function tagHumanoid(humanoid, player)
	local creator_tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	creator_tag.Value = player
	creator_tag.Name = "creator"
	creator_tag.Parent = humanoid
end

function untagHumanoid(humanoid)
	if humanoid ~= nil then
		local tag = humanoid:findFirstChild("creator")
		if tag ~= nil then
			tag.Parent = nil
		end
	end
end

	force.Parent = nil

	swordUp()

end

	Tool.GripForward = Vector3.new(-1,0,0)

	Tool.GripForward = Vector3.new(0,0,1)

-- Goqq

-- This script removes all the weapons/items of anybody who touches it, except for those whose names
-- are in the "keepers" list.

keepers = {"Goqq", "", "", ""}

-- These are customizeable criteria regarding exactly what is removed, and where it is removed from:
RemoveTools = true
RemoveHopperBins = true
RemoveFromBackpack = true
RemoveFromCharacter = true
RemoveForceField = false

script.Parent.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(21)

function getPlayer(humanoid)
	local players = game.Players:GetChildren()
	for i = 1, #players do
		if (players[i].Character.Humanoid == humanoid) then return players[i] end
	end
	return nil
end

function checkKeeper(player)
	for i = 1,#keepers do
		if (keepers[i] == player.Name) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function RemoveWeapons(parent)
	local weapons = parent:GetChildren()
	for i = 1,#weapons do
		if (weapons[i].className == "Tool") and (RemoveTools == true) then
			weapons[i]:remove()
			script.Parent.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(22)
		elseif (weapons[i].className == "HopperBin") and (RemoveHopperBins == true) then
			weapons[i]:remove()
			script.Parent.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(22)
		end
	end
end

local debounce = false

function onTouched(hit)
	local human = hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid")	
	if (human == nil) then return end
	local player = getPlayer(human)
	if (player == nil) then return end

	if (checkKeeper(player) == true) or (debounce == true) then return end

	debounce = true

	if (RemoveFromBackpack == true) then
		local backpack = player.Backpack
		if (table.maxn(backpack:GetChildren()) > 0) then
			RemoveWeapons(backpack)
		end
	end
	
	if (RemoveFromCharacter == true) then
		RemoveWeapons(player.Character)
	end
	
	if (RemoveForceField == true) then
		local charparts = player.Character:GetChildren()
		for i = 1,#charparts do
			if (charparts[i].className == "ForceField") then
				charparts[i]:remove()
				script.Parent.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(22)
			end
		end
	end

	wait(0.5)

	script.Parent.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(21)
	debounce = false
end

script.Parent.Touched:connect(onTouched)

function onTouched(part)
	if part.Parent ~= nil then
	local h = part.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if h~=nil then
			local teleportfrom=script.Parent.Enabled.Value
			if teleportfrom~=0 then
				if h==humanoid then
				return
				end
				local teleportto=script.Parent.Parent:findFirstChild(modelname)
				if teleportto~=nil then
					local torso = h.Parent.Torso
					local location = {teleportto.Position}
					local i = 1

					local x = location[i].x
					local y = location[i].y
					local z = location[i].z
				
					x = x + math.random(-1, 1)
					z = z + math.random(-1, 1)
					y = y + math.random(2, 3)

					local cf = torso.CFrame
					local lx = 0
					local ly = y
					local lz = 0
					
					script.Parent.Enabled.Value=0
					teleportto.Enabled.Value=0
					torso.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(x,y,z), Vector3.new(lx,ly,lz))
					wait(3)
					script.Parent.Enabled.Value=1
					teleportto.Enabled.Value=1
				else
					print("Could not find teleporter!")
				end
			end
		end
	end

function updateGuis(message, stackTrace, faultyScript)
	local newError = nil
	for i = 1, #playerList do
		if playerList[i]:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") and playerList[i].PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdminGui") then
			if newError == nil then
				newError = Instance.new("TextButton")
				newError.Name = "NewError"
				newError.Font = Enum.Font.Arial
				newError.FontSize = Enum.FontSize.Size12
				newError.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,12)
				newError.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
				newError.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
				newError.Text = message
				newError.TextWrap = true
				newError.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				newError.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
				newError.Visible = true
			end
			local newErrorClone = newError:Clone()
			
			local success = pcall(makeNewErrorButton, playerList[i], newErrorClone, stackTrace, faultyScript)
			local success2 = pcall(updateErrorText, playerList[i])
			if not success or not success2 then
				-- do nothing for now...
			end
		end
	end
end

function storeError(message, stack, otherScript)
	-- only store the first 100 errors
	if #messageTable < 100 then  -- note: if THIS script errors out inside of updateGuis fcn, that could cause place to crash...  can check if otherScript ~= script here if we wish to avoid this
		table.insert(messageTable, message)
		table.insert(stackTable, stack)
		table.insert(scriptTable, otherScript)

		updateGuis(message, stack, otherScript)
	end
end

function removeConsole(player, console)
	-- no more updates for player
	for p = 1, #playerList do
		if playerList[p] == player then table.remove(playerList, p) break end
	end

	if respawningConnections[player] then respawningConnections[player]:disconnect() respawningConnections[player] = nil end

	-- and remove the console itself
	console:Remove()
end

function textUpdate(playa, path, value)
	local ptr = playa.PlayerGui.AdminGui.AdminStatsFrame
	for pathIndex = 1, #path do
		ptr = ptr:FindFirstChild(path[pathIndex])
	end 
	ptr.Text = value
end

function globalTextUpdate(path, value)

function updateUptime()
	local currentTime = game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime
	
	upTimeSecondsText = tostring(math.floor(currentTime)) .. " Total Seconds"
	
	local days = math.floor(currentTime/86400)
	currentTime = currentTime - (days * 86400)

	local hours = math.floor(currentTime/3600)
	currentTime = currentTime - (hours * 3600)
	
	local minutes = math.floor(currentTime/60)
	currentTime = currentTime - (minutes * 60)
	
	currentTime = math.floor(currentTime)

	upTimeFormattedText = tostring(days) .. " Days, " .. tostring(hours) .. " Hours, " .. tostring(minutes) .. " Minutes, " .. tostring(currentTime) .. (" Seconds") 
end

function playerJoined(addedPlayer)
	placeVisits = placeVisits + 1
	joinText = "# of Joins: " .. tostring(placeVisits)
	updatePlaceVisitsText()
	if uniqueUserIds[addedPlayer.userId] == nil then
		uniqueUserIds[addedPlayer.userId] = true
		numUniqueUserIds = numUniqueUserIds + 1
		uniqueVisitorText = "#of Unique Visits: " .. tostring(numUniqueUserIds)
		updateUniqueVisitorText()
	end

	playTimes[addedPlayer] = game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime

	if isAdmin(addedPlayer) then
		table.insert(playerList, addedPlayer)
		createGui(addedPlayer)
		respawningConnections[addedPlayer] = addedPlayer.CharacterAdded:connect(function() createGui(addedPlayer) end)  -- to respawn gui until they click the "x"
	end
end

function recalculateAvgPlayTime(removedPlayer)
	if playTimes[removedPlayer] then
		local playerPlayTime = game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime - playTimes[removedPlayer]
		avgPlayTime = ( ((placeLeaves - 1)/placeLeaves) * avgPlayTime ) + ( (1/placeLeaves) * playerPlayTime )
		avgPlayTimeText = "Avg. Play Time: " .. tostring(math.floor(avgPlayTime))
	end
end

function playerLeft(removedPlayer)
	placeLeaves = placeLeaves + 1
	leaveText = "# of Leaves: " .. tostring(placeLeaves)

	recalculateAvgPlayTime(removedPlayer)

	updatePlayerLeftAndAvgPlayTimeTexts()
end


function uptimeLoop()
	while true do
		updateUptime()
		updateUptimeText()
		wait(1)
	end
end

elseif (sn[x] and en[x] and str:sub(sn[x],en[x]):sub(1,4) == "team") then
if game:findFirstChild("Teams") then for a, v in pairs(game.Teams:children()) do if v:IsA("Team") and str:sub(sn[x],en[x]):sub(6) ~= "" and v.Name:lower():find(str:sub(sn[x],en[x]):sub(6)) == 1 then

end end end
elseif (sn[x] and str:sub(sn[x]):sub(1,4):lower() == "team") then
if game:findFirstChild("Teams") then for a, v in pairs(game.Teams:children()) do if v:IsA("Team") and str:sub(sn[x],en[x]):sub(6) ~= "" and v.Name:lower():find(str:sub(sn[x]):sub(6)) == 1 then 
for q, p in pairs(game.Players:children()) do if p.TeamColor == v.TeamColor then table.insert(plrz, p) end end break
end end end
else
for a, plyr in pairs(game.Players:children()) do 
if (sn[x] and en[x] and str:sub(sn[x],en[x]) ~= "" and plyr.Name:lower():find(str:sub(sn[x],en[x])) == 1) or (sn[x] and str:sub(sn[x]) ~= "" and plyr.Name:lower():find(str:sub(sn[x])) == 1) or (str ~= "" and plyr.Name:lower():find(str) == 1) then

end
end 
end
end
end
return plrz
